task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 132 to 132 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "maple" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "urgent" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

candidate.text:
Dear team,

This message provides a quick update on the ongoing project. We’ve made significant strides in finalizing the initial designs, particularly around the user interface elements. Several members have contributed excellent ideas, and the collaborative spirit has been fantastic. Remember to document all changes meticulously, referencing the latest style guide. We're particularly focused on ensuring a seamless experience, drawing inspiration from the natural flow of a beautiful maple forest. Please review the revised mockups available on the shared drive and provide feedback by the end of the week. This is a crucial stage, and your input is highly valued.

Let’s continue this momentum and deliver a truly exceptional product. Please reach out if you encounter any roadblocks or require assistance. We are confident that by working together, we can overcome any challenges and achieve our objectives. The goal is a polished, user-friendly application. Keep up the great work!

Kind regards.
